operating_notes.text: Bagged ₹27.74 Cr order from PTCUL for 132 kV transmission line conductor replacement, to be executed in 10 months.
Incorporated three 80% subsidiaries: Advait Battery Ecosystems, Advait Carbon Advisory & Renewables Assets, and Advait Unified Renewable Assets.
Entered into an MoU with TECO Fuel Cell Technology AS, Norway, for hydrogen fuel cell technology collaboration.
FY26 consolidated revenue split: PTS ₹459.16 Cr, NRE ₹268.09 Cr; NRE segment result ₹13.95 Cr.
FY26 capex was ₹112.57 Cr with CWIP of ₹59.28 Cr at March 2026.
Advait Energy Holding AS, a foreign subsidiary, was struck off effective 27 March 2026.

FY26 Reg. 32 statement: ₹24.40 Cr of the ₹82.30 Cr preferential raise utilised till 31.03.2026, with ₹6.93 Cr shifted from working capital and general corporate purposes into plant and machinery capex.
5,630 warrants were forfeited in FY26 for non-payment of the 75% balance by two holders, leaving ₹74,99,160 uncollected and zero warrants outstanding.
Consolidated order book reached ₹1,304 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Incorporated Advait BESS Bhesaan Private Limited as a 51% subsidiary on May 27, 2026, for BESS EPC and turnkey services.

Advait BESS Bhesaan Private Limited executed a BESPA with GUVNL on June 1, 2026 for a 150 MW/300 MWh standalone BESS project near GETCO's 220kV Bhesan AIS substation in Gujarat, with a 12-year execution period.
Order execution timeline is 6 to 18 months depending on the business.
Solar EPC physical capacity is close to 100-200 MW a year.
BESS AC-to-AC losses are 5-7.5%, with 1-2% annual degradation.
Advait Energy joined a consortium led by Eleven Power Private Limited for electricity distribution in Gurugram and Nuh districts.
Board approved acquisition of additional shares in AURA (reaching 90%) and Advait Greenergy (reaching 79.65%).
Order book reached ₹1,574.83 Cr at Q2FY27 end, with PTS contributing 68% and NRE accounting for 32%.
Advait Battery Ecosystem Private Limited setting up 2.5 GWh BESS assembly facility at Gangad, Gujarat.

timeline.summary: Advait Energy Transitions informed the exchange about bagging a ₹27.74 Cr conductor replacement order from PTCUL on April 21, 2026.
Advait Energy Transitions incorporated three subsidiaries for battery systems, carbon advisory, and renewable assets.
Advait Energy Transitions signed an MoU with Norway's TECO Fuel Cell Technology for hydrogen fuel cells during the 3rd India-Nordic Summit.
Shalin Sheth (Managing Director) declared no encumbrance on Advait Energy Transitions Limited shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹228.2 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹17.67 Cr.
Advait Energy Transitions filed its Reg. 32 statement for FY26, reporting no deviation in the ₹82.30 Cr preferential issue and 5,630 warrants forfeited for non-payment.
Advait Energy Transitions released its Q4FY26 and FY26 investor presentation on May 27, 2026, reporting ₹714.52 Cr consolidated revenue and a ₹1,304 Cr order book.
Advait Energy Transitions incorporated a 51% subsidiary, Advait BESS Bhesaan Private Limited, to undertake BESS turnkey and EPC solutions.
Advait Energy Transitions Limited shared the audio recording of its Post Results Conference Call for Q4FY26 and FY26 on June 01, 2026, via its website.
Advait Energy Transitions subsidiary Advait BESS Bhesaan executed a 12-year Battery Energy Storage Purchase Agreement with GUVNL for a 150 MW/300 MWh BESS project in Gujarat.
Rutvi Sheth, Promoter Group, declared no encumbrance on Advait Energy’s shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Advait Energy Transitions' Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue growth of 40%+, an order book of ₹1,600-1,650 Cr and capex of ₹300-350 Cr.
Advait Energy Transitions joined a consortium led by Eleven Power Private Limited following the grant of an electricity distribution licence for Gurugram and Nuh by HERC.
Advait Energy reports Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹220.94 Cr, up 39% YoY
Advait Energy Transitions reported Q2FY27 consolidated net profit growth of 88.5% YoY to ₹19.18 Cr with order book at ₹1,574.83 Cr.
